# anythink s.r.o.

> Softwarové studio / software studio. Based in Prague and surrounding area; projects nationwide in CZ.
> Custom software development, engineering capacity for teams, and shared product development.
> House products: Cerebrio (real-estate CRM) in development; hospitality and warehouse planned.

## Stack (public)

TypeScript, Rust, Python, Go, PostgreSQL.

## Services

1. Build to order / Vývoj na míru — end-to-end custom software (websites and applications, APIs, platforms)
2. Capacity in your team / Kapacita do týmu — experienced engineers embedded in client process
3. Shared product development / Sdílený produktový vývoj — longer collaboration on product direction and engineering
